metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and skills maintained by Gep

plugins.name: destructive-guard
plugins.description: Deterministic PreToolUse approval gate, configured through env variables. By default asks before destructive commands on the local machine or cloud services; optional rule packs, an optional Jev classifier and a check skill to dry-run calls.

plugins.name: gated-dev-simple-workflow
plugins.description: File-based ticket-to-PR pipeline: /ticket runs spec, plan, dev and review subagents in a worktree per ticket (git, Orca or iTerm2), with a plan-approval checkpoint and PR creation, plus a launcher that opens one session per ticket and notifies you when a launched session needs you. Treats approval-gate prompts as checkpoints; no gate required.
